title: mail-server: emailpush feature skeleton (EmailPushAccount, EmailPushBackend, EmailPushError, URI re-export)
description:
Design: docs/design/emailpush.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: E5. Crates: jmap-mail-server. Size: S.

Spec: draft-ietf-jmap-emailpush-05 §2.1, §4. Design: docs/design/emailpush.md §3, §6; decisions 3, 10, 16 and 20 in docs/design/DECISIONS.md.

In crate-jmap-mail-server add feature emailpush = ["jmap-mail-types/emailpush", "dep:jmap-metadata-server"] (metadata-server stays optional: enabled by memory or emailpush only), and pub mod emailpush (emailpush/mod.rs) with private validate/deliver submodules declared empty. Items: #[non_exhaustive] EmailPushAccount { mail, object_ids, email_history, filter_conditions, properties extras } with new() and setters (email_history defaults to false; it is true exactly when the account's object-history capability lists Email, decision 10); trait EmailPushBackend: jmap_server::PushSubscriptionBackend (NOT a MailBackend subtrait, decision 3) with required email_push_accounts(caller) -> Result<BTreeMap<Id, EmailPushAccount>, Error> (rustdoc MUST: exactly the accounts advertised with the emailpush account capability; consumer MUSTs from §6, including: create_push_subscription and update_push_subscription MUST call check_email_push_change before storing and store the normalized result, since PushSubscriptionBackend has no validation hook (decision 16); each DeliveredEmail is built from a full Email, with placeholder id/blobId/threadId/mailboxIds where the deployment has no ObjectID (decision 20)); #[non_exhaustive] EmailPushError { LimitTooSmall, MissingThreadKeywords }; re-export EmailCondition from filter.rs; re-export JMAP_EMAILPUSH_URI at the crate root like JMAP_MDN_URI. Widen filter.rs to cfg(any(feature = "memory", feature = "emailpush")).
Acceptance: the crate builds and tests with no features, with emailpush alone, and with memory alone (cargo hack or explicit feature runs); plain mail-server users gain no deps; public-api snapshot refreshed.
